items.title: Stella says more McLaren parts are planned for Las Vegas
items.summary: After the São Paulo Grand Prix, McLaren Team Principal Andrea Stella said more parts would arrive at Las Vegas to complement the Interlagos package and form a foundation for the 2027 car. He did not identify specific components or their intended effect.
items.why_it_matters: This is an early team statement, not an FIA declaration. The public event-document listing could not be verified today, so no component, geometry or performance claim should be inferred before a source filing is reviewed.

sources.label: Formula1.com Andrea Stella on McLaren's next package
